title: Transport separable generation across residue-field equivalence

source.place: Tag 030O (definition); invariance proved directly from Mathlib primitives

statement: Let K, K-prime, E be fields, with K- and K-prime-algebra structures on E, and a ring equivalence e: K to K-prime such that the image of x under K to E equals the image of e(x) under K-prime to E for every x. If E/K-prime is separably generated [def-weil-pbc-separable-field-extension], then E/K is separably generated.

proof.text: Apply algebraicIndependent_ringHom_iff_of_comp_eq to e and the identity of E. This preserves algebraic independence in both directions, and therefore preserves maximality and the chosen transcendence basis.

The two coefficient maps have the same range because e is surjective. The generated intermediate fields have equal underlying subfields; RingEquiv.subfieldCongr gives their identity equivalence. Algebra.IsSeparable.of_equiv_equiv transports separability across it, proving the desired definition.

lean.statement:
theorem separablyGenerated_of_residueField_equiv
    (K K' E : Type u) [Field K] [Field K'] [Field E]
    (e : K ≃+* K') [Algebra K E] [Algebra K' E]
    (hcompat : ∀ x : K, algebraMap K E x = algebraMap K' E (e x))
    (h : Algebra.IsSeparablyGenerated K' E) :
    Algebra.IsSeparablyGenerated K E
